name: Portuguese Sausage, Potato & Leafy Greens Soup (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 3 medium food storage containers.
Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, cut the sausages crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces.

Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove cooked sausage to a plate and set aside. (Reserve pan with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tomato
1 leek
½ bunch kale
½ (5 oz) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, small dice tomato. Place in a medium bowl.

Trim off root end and dark green top of the leek, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut leek in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces. Add to the bowl with the tomato.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.

Return the pan (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tomato, leek, garlic, and spices; cook stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp paprika
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, quarter, and slice potatoes into ½-inch thick pieces.
When the veggies are starting to soften, add potatoes and broth to the pan, then stir to combine the soup. Bring to a boil over high heat.

While the soup comes to a boil, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Once the soup is boiling, add kale to the pan in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until potatoes and kale are tender, about 8 minutes.
When the potatoes and kale are tender, add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Add cooked sausage, stir to combine, and remove from heat.

Divide soup between the storage containers, then set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour. Once cool, cover containers and refrigerate. When ready to eat, heat soup in a saucepan or microwave and enjoy!
